_notes: Keycloak 26 realm 'k8sgateway' running in the kind cluster (deploy/idp/keycloak).
The SPA client 'angular-app' is public (Client authentication OFF), Standard flow ON, PKCE S256.
Valid redirect URIs: http://angular.127.0.0.1.nip.io/*  Web origins: http://angular.127.0.0.1.nip.io
Realm roles land in the ACCESS token under realm_access.roles (not in the ID token by default).
Do NOT add offline_access: Keycloak issues a normal refresh token for the code flow anyway, and offline_access
would turn it into an OFFLINE token (never expires, survives logout, needs the offline_access role).
